description: Independent asynchronous compressed-video decoder ownership. Packet parsing and DPB stay in R4VIDEO; GPU execution and composition keep their existing owners.

functions.name: open

operation.ownership: Caller serializes operations on each owner; different decoder owners may run concurrently. Keep this R4L and all referenced platform/backend providers loaded through final acknowledgement.

functions.description: Bind actual process/platform providers. Creates bounded runtime ownership; no GPU/decoder admission yet.

functions.name: query_caps

operation.ownership: Caller serializes operations on each owner; different decoder owners may run concurrently. Keep this R4L and all referenced platform/backend providers loaded through final acknowledgement.

functions.description: Query actual installed codec/backend limits; unsupported never falls back implicitly.

functions.name: create

operation.ownership: Caller serializes operations on each owner; different decoder owners may run concurrently. Keep this R4L and all referenced platform/backend providers loaded through final acknowledgement.

functions.description: Copy immutable admission and reserve budgets; worker and codec allocation may block. Initial stream generation is 1.

functions.name: send

operation.ownership: Caller serializes operations on each owner; different decoder owners may run concurrently. Keep this R4L and all referenced platform/backend providers loaded through final acknowledgement.

functions.description: Copy one complete compressed access unit into a bounded queue. Does not decode or wait for GPU; zero-copy ownership is not implied.

functions.name: receive

operation.ownership: Caller serializes operations on each owner; different decoder owners may run concurrently. Keep this R4L and all referenced platform/backend providers loaded through final acknowledgement.

functions.description: Acquire next successfully decoded frame in display order. AGAIN means no ready output; EOS only after Drain and queued output exhaustion. Outputs unchanged on failure.

functions.name: release

operation.ownership: Caller serializes operations on each owner; different decoder owners may run concurrently. Keep this R4L and all referenced platform/backend providers loaded through final acknowledgement.

functions.description: Return exact lease after last use. AGAIN retains immutable receipt/fence ownership; retry unchanged until OK. Acknowledged tokens are idempotent until their slot is reused; later retries are STALE and cannot release another frame.

functions.name: control

operation.ownership: Caller serializes operations on each owner; different decoder owners may run concurrently. Keep this R4L and all referenced platform/backend providers loaded through final acknowledgement.

functions.description: Query/queue Drain, Flush or Close. Query creates no progress itself. Worker owns retirement. Close does not destroy the decoder handle; destroy follows completed Close.

functions.name: destroy

operation.ownership: Caller serializes operations on each owner; different decoder owners may run concurrently. Keep this R4L and all referenced platform/backend providers loaded through final acknowledgement.

functions.description: Remove a closed decoder only after worker quiescence and every frame receipt. BUSY retains owner for retry; successful removal makes the handle stale.

functions.name: finish

operation.ownership: Caller serializes operations on each owner; different decoder owners may run concurrently. Keep this R4L and all referenced platform/backend providers loaded through final acknowledgement.

functions.description: After all decoder handles are destroyed, stop/join runtime workers and retire native state. BUSY retains ownership for retry; success closes the runtime permanently.

interfaces.description: Asynchronous, generation-safe compressed-video API. This interface revision is independent of admitted codec profiles.

types.name: R4VideoRuntime

fields.name: address
fields.description: Opaque library-owned address; never dereference.

fields.name: generation
fields.description: Non-reused owner generation; both fields zero mean absent.

types.description: Exact process/provider-local owner. Keep the R4L provider loaded through destruction.

types.name: R4VideoDecoder

fields.name: address
fields.description: Opaque library-owned address; never dereference.

fields.name: generation
fields.description: Non-reused owner generation; both fields zero mean absent.

types.description: Exact process/provider-local owner. Keep the R4L provider loaded through destruction.

types.name: R4VideoStartup

fields.name: version
fields.description: Must be 1.

fields.name: size
fields.description: Must equal the complete fixed payload size.

fields.name: application
fields.description: Address of actual R4XStartContext; immutable imports/platform tables follow application lifetime.

fields.name: memory_limit
fields.description: Aggregate charged bytes for allocation payloads/headers/alignment, decoder/DPB, output BOs and worker stack reservations. Excludes shared provider code, fixed process/TLS metadata, backing-heap caches and kernel bookkeeping; not a total physical-RAM cap.

fields.name: max_decoders
fields.description: Maximum concurrently resident decoders, including closing owners; current implementation accepts 1..16.

fields.name: thread_limit
fields.description: Aggregate decoder worker cap, including decoder coordinators; zero selects bounded scheduler capacity. One fixed retirement worker is additional and its memory remains charged.

types.description: Copied startup configuration; application and imported provider generations remain alive through finish.

types.name: R4VideoCapsQuery

fields.name: version
fields.description: Must be 1.

fields.name: size
fields.description: Must equal the complete fixed payload size.

fields.name: backend
fields.description: Explicit software=0 or NVIDIA=1; never silently substitute.

fields.name: adapter_id
fields.description: Native exact adapter; zero for software.

fields.name: codec
fields.description: Compressed codec identity.

fields.name: profile
fields.description: Codec profile; zero asks the codec default. Software H.264 currently resolves zero to Baseline; query output reports the resolved profile.

fields.name: bit_depth
fields.description: Requested component bit depth.

fields.name: chroma
fields.description: Requested chroma subsampling identity.

types.description: Query an installed implementation and its current backend admission; no decoder allocation.

types.name: R4VideoCaps

fields.name: version
fields.description: Must be 1.

fields.name: size
fields.description: Must equal the complete fixed payload size.

fields.name: query
fields.description: Resolved profile and backend; actual queried identity.

fields.name: min_width
fields.description: Smallest coded luma width.

fields.name: min_height
fields.description: Smallest coded luma height.

fields.name: max_width
fields.description: Largest admitted coded luma width.

fields.name: max_height
fields.description: Largest admitted coded luma height.

fields.name: max_level
fields.description: Codec level in its native integer convention.

fields.name: output_formats
fields.description: Bitmask of supported common video pixel layouts.

fields.name: max_packet_bytes
fields.description: Maximum compressed access-unit bytes.

fields.name: max_pending_packets
fields.description: Maximum copied input queue capacity.

fields.name: max_frame_leases
fields.description: Maximum simultaneous consumer frame loans.

fields.name: device_generation
fields.description: Native exact device generation; zero for software.

fields.name: reset_generation
fields.description: Native reset generation; zero for software.

fields.name: flags
fields.description: Must be zero in revision 1; no implicit hardware qualification bit.

fields.name: reserved
fields.description: Must be zero.

types.description: Only an installed, admitted codec profile returns success. Declaration is not a physical hardware qualification.

types.name: R4VideoConfig

fields.name: version
fields.description: Must be 1.

fields.name: size
fields.description: Must equal the complete fixed payload size.

fields.name: query
fields.description: Immutable backend/codec/profile selection.

fields.name: memory_limit
fields.description: Per-decoder budget including compressed queues, surfaces and DPB; bounded by runtime budget.

fields.name: max_width
fields.description: Caller upper bound on coded width.

fields.name: max_height
fields.description: Caller upper bound on coded height.

fields.name: pending_packets
fields.description: Requested finite copied packet queue capacity.

fields.name: frame_leases
fields.description: Requested finite output loan capacity; DPB is additional but budgeted.

fields.name: threads
fields.description: Per-decoder worker cap including its coordinator, currently 1..16; zero selects runtime policy. An implementation may use fewer workers.

fields.name: flags
fields.description: Must be zero in revision 1.

types.description: Create an asynchronous decoder. Dimension changes within limits use the same stream; unsupported changes report an error instead of corrupting old leases.

types.name: R4VideoPacket

fields.name: version
fields.description: Must be 1.

fields.name: size
fields.description: Must equal the complete fixed payload size.

fields.name: data_address
fields.description: Borrowed complete Annex-B access-unit bytes, read only during send.

fields.name: data_bytes
fields.description: Exact readable extent. R4VIDEO copies bytes and required decoder padding before success.

fields.name: stream_generation
fields.description: Must equal the current decoder stream generation.

fields.name: tag
fields.description: Caller correlation value carried to its decoded picture; not a timestamp.

fields.name: pts_ns
fields.description: Presentation timestamp in caller media timeline; valid only with packet_pts.

fields.name: dts_ns
fields.description: Decode timestamp in same timeline; valid only with packet_dts.

fields.name: duration_ns
fields.description: Duration when packet_duration is set; otherwise zero.

fields.name: flags
fields.description: Timestamp/duration validity bits only; one complete access unit per call.

fields.name: reserved
fields.description: Must be zero.

types.description: Input is never retained as a borrowed pointer. AGAIN accepts nothing; OK accepts the entire unit exactly once. PTS may differ from decode order.

types.name: R4VideoBuffer

fields.name: id
fields.description: Canonical GfxBufferHandle.id.

fields.name: reserved0
fields.description: Must be zero.

fields.name: generation
fields.description: Canonical GfxBufferHandle.generation.

types.description: ABI-compatible view of a common graphics BO/reference handle, not a CPU address.

types.name: R4VideoFence

fields.name: slot
fields.description: Canonical GfxFence slot.

fields.name: adapter_id
fields.description: Queue adapter identity.

fields.name: timeline
fields.description: Queue timeline.

fields.name: point
fields.description: Queue point.

fields.name: device_generation
fields.description: Exact device lifetime.

fields.name: reset_generation
fields.description: Exact reset lifetime.

types.description: Canonical common queue fence layout. All-zero means no consumer GPU submission; any nonzero value must be exact.

types.name: R4VideoPlane

fields.name: buffer
fields.description: Underlying graphics buffer identity.

fields.name: reference
fields.description: Borrowed frame-owned reference, never release directly; consumers may create independent references.

fields.name: offset
fields.description: Plane byte offset in this BO.

fields.name: pitch
fields.description: Logical row pitch in bytes. Actual BO descriptor modifier governs addressing; tiled planes are not linear CPU rows.

fields.name: row_bytes
fields.description: Active logical row bytes, excluding padding. Interpret together with the actual BO layout/modifier.

fields.name: rows
fields.description: Plane row count.

fields.name: reserved
fields.description: Must be zero.

types.description: A plane view checked against the real BO descriptor. Multiple planes may share one reference; the enclosing frame owns the deduplicated loan.

types.name: R4VideoColor

fields.name: version
fields.description: Must be 1.

fields.name: size
fields.description: Must equal the complete fixed payload size.

fields.name: primaries
fields.description: CICP color_primaries code point from stream; 2 means unspecified. Not an R4GFX RGB enum.

fields.name: transfer
fields.description: CICP transfer_characteristics code point from stream; 2 means unspecified. Do not substitute sRGB for BT.709.

fields.name: range
fields.description: Common range identity: 0 unknown, 1 full, 2 limited at bit_depth. No guessed default.

fields.name: matrix
fields.description: CICP matrix_coefficients code point from stream; 2 means unspecified. Independent of primaries and transfer.

fields.name: chroma_location
fields.description: Chroma sample position relative to luma.

fields.name: bit_depth
fields.description: Number of meaningful bits per component.

fields.name: reference_white
fields.description: Reference-white luminance in 1/10000 cd/m2; valid only with color_reference_white, otherwise zero.

fields.name: peak
fields.description: Peak luminance in 1/10000 cd/m2; valid only with color_luminance, otherwise zero.

fields.name: black
fields.description: Black luminance in 1/10000 cd/m2; valid only with color_luminance, otherwise zero.

fields.name: flags
fields.description: color_reference_white and color_luminance only. Missing metadata is preserved; policy belongs to presentation.

types.description: Copied per-frame color metadata. Conversion, scaling and output color policy belong to R4GFX/Desktop.

types.name: R4VideoLease

fields.name: decoder
fields.description: Decoder owner retained through Return acknowledgement.

fields.name: token
fields.description: Non-reused lease token within decoder lifetime.

fields.name: stream_generation
fields.description: Generation which produced this picture, retained across Flush.

types.description: Exact consumer acquisition; storage stays owned until release acknowledges it. Not invalidated by seek alone.

types.name: R4VideoFrame

fields.name: version
fields.description: Must be 1.

fields.name: size
fields.description: Must equal the complete fixed payload size.

fields.name: lease
fields.description: Exact frame lease.

fields.name: tag
fields.description: Associated compressed input correlation tag.

fields.name: pts_ns
fields.description: Presentation timestamp, validity in flags.

fields.name: dts_ns
fields.description: Decode timestamp, validity in flags.

fields.name: duration_ns
fields.description: Media duration, validity in flags.

fields.name: coded_width
fields.description: Decoded luma storage width.

fields.name: coded_height
fields.description: Decoded luma storage height.

fields.name: crop_x
fields.description: Visible rectangle luma origin.

fields.name: crop_y
fields.description: Visible rectangle luma origin.

fields.name: crop_width
fields.description: Visible width wholly within coded extent.

fields.name: crop_height
fields.description: Visible height wholly within coded extent.

fields.name: sar_num
fields.description: Positive sample-aspect numerator.

fields.name: sar_den
fields.description: Positive sample-aspect denominator.

fields.name: format
fields.description: Common pixel layout identity, not bitmask.

fields.name: plane_count
fields.description: Two for NV12/P010, three for YUV420P.

fields.name: color
fields.description: Original per-frame metadata.

fields.name: plane0
fields.description: Luma.

fields.name: plane1
fields.description: Interleaved chroma or U.

fields.name: plane2
fields.description: V for planar YUV420P; otherwise all zero.

fields.name: ready
fields.description: Retained producer completion metadata. Receive already checks successful decode status.

fields.name: flags
fields.description: Timestamp/duration validity and picture flags.

fields.name: reserved
fields.description: Must be zero.

types.description: Receive transfers one output lease in display/reorder order; failed or concealed-corrupt pictures are not reported as successful outputs. No mandatory CPU color conversion.

types.name: R4VideoReceipt

fields.name: version
fields.description: Must be 1.

fields.name: size
fields.description: Must equal the complete fixed payload size.

fields.name: fence
fields.description: Last real consumer dependency; held through release acknowledgement.

fields.name: result
fields.description: Zero successful consumption; negative denotes discarded/failed consumption, never successful recycling.

fields.name: reserved
fields.description: Must be zero.

types.description: Call only after ending CPU mappings/readers and submitting the final GPU use. A pending release retains this exact immutable receipt for retries.

types.name: R4VideoControl

fields.name: version
fields.description: Must be 1.

fields.name: size
fields.description: Must equal the complete fixed payload size.

fields.name: request_id
fields.description: Strictly increasing mutation ID per decoder. Query uses zero; identical latest retries are idempotent.

fields.name: operation
fields.description: Query=0, drain=1, flush=2, close=3.

fields.name: reserved
fields.description: Must be zero.

types.description: Nonblocking control. Accepted mutation is not completion; query state until completed_request equals request_id. Conflicts while another operation is pending return BUSY.

types.name: R4VideoState

fields.name: version
fields.description: Must be 1.

fields.name: size
fields.description: Must equal the complete fixed payload size.

fields.name: stream_generation
fields.description: Monotone generation starts at 1; successful Flush advances exactly once.

fields.name: pending_request
fields.description: Current control ID or zero.

fields.name: completed_request
fields.description: Last completed control ID.

fields.name: memory_bytes
fields.description: Currently owned bytes including held old-generation outputs.

fields.name: phase
fields.description: Decoder phase.

fields.name: queued_packets
fields.description: Accepted input packets not yet consumed.

fields.name: ready_frames
fields.description: Outputs waiting for receive.

fields.name: leased_frames
fields.description: Frames still held by consumers, including pending receipts.

fields.name: last_error
fields.description: Sticky terminal decoder error or zero.

fields.name: reserved
fields.description: Must be zero.

types.description: Copied progress snapshot. Drain preserves reordered outputs; Flush discards unleased old outputs, resets parser/DPB and rejects stale-generation inputs. Close retains storage until all leases/worker resources retire.

constants.description: Operation succeeded; control acceptance is distinct from worker completion.
No ready output or release pending.
Drain complete and output queue empty.
16-bit little-endian storage, 10 high bits meaningful; low six bits zero.
No signaled matrix; host policy must resolve it.
Drain completed; Flush required before new input.
Terminal decode/backend error; Close still required.
Discard unleased output and reset stream generation.
Stop decoder; preserve external frame loans.
Peak and black luminance are present.
CICP unspecified primaries, transfer or matrix.

errors.description: Invalid header, enum, pointer extent or inconsistent data.
Wrong owner, frame token, request or stream generation.
Malformed compressed input or failed decoder status.
Owner is closing or closed; no new work allowed.

ownership_rules.name: Runtime lifetime
ownership_rules.text: All state belongs to the actual caller process and this loaded provider generation. No singleton decoder, global caller budget or ambient desktop dependency.

ownership_rules.name: Backpressure
ownership_rules.text: Queues and packet sizes are finite. Send success accepts the complete copied unit; AGAIN or error accepts nothing. Receive follows codec display order, never blindly input/DTS order.

ownership_rules.name: Frame lifetime
ownership_rules.text: DPB references, in-flight GPU work and consumer loans are independent. Flush/Close never revoke a delivered frame. The producer holds BOs and completion metadata until exact release acknowledgement.

ownership_rules.name: Clock ownership
ownership_rules.text: PTS/DTS are media timeline values, not wall-clock ticks. Decode runs asynchronously; the media host schedules presentation/audio and owns pause/seek clock changes.

ownership_rules.name: Controls
ownership_rules.text: Monotone request IDs make Drain/Flush/Close retries idempotent. Accepted is not completed. Flush advances stream generation only once after old work ends; Close retains the handle until explicit destroy.

ownership_rules.name: Graphics ownership
ownership_rules.text: Frame layouts reuse common BO/fence identities. R4GFX/Desktop owns YUV conversion, scaling, colorspace and output; native decode does not require a CPU RGB copy.

ownership_rules.name: Incomplete implementation
ownership_rules.text: This contract is the 0.79.40 implementation target. Generating bindings or passing ABI checks does not enable any decoder or constitute software/hardware acceptance.

ownership_rules.name: Canonical storage
ownership_rules.text: Each plane is a view of the queried canonical BO descriptor, including its modifier, extent, placement and device lifetime. Pitch alone never implies linear CPU access. Unknown layouts are unsupported; a renderer must not reinterpret them.

ownership_rules.name: Failed controls
ownership_rules.text: Flush completes successfully only after prior work retires and stream_generation advances once. A failed Flush leaves the old generation and phase_failed; only query, release, Close and destroy remain legal. Close completion includes all worker and lease retirement. Query is allowed until destroy.

ownership_rules.name: Acknowledgement retention
ownership_rules.text: Release retries retain the exact immutable receipt until OK. Idempotence is guaranteed while that acknowledged slot has not been reused. After reuse an old token returns STALE and cannot affect a new lease. Never retry a successfully acknowledged token after acquiring another frame.

ownership_rules.name: Color provenance
ownership_rules.text: CICP primaries, transfer and matrix preserve the signaled stream values. Unknown values remain unspecified; unsupported known values must not silently become sRGB, BT.709 or HDR. Range, chroma siting and coded/crop geometry are independent metadata.
